whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Suto Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.8★ reviews at Saguna More in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/suto

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Suto Cafe Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Suto Cafe at Saguna More) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a digital menu showcase for your Patna location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai. Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
